story.body: You altered three cue-words so that Cowley would not enter on the wrong lord. The new words are Lord Hastings, my liege, and madam. Larkham recopied the two rolls and did not speak. You told Nick to breathe before he is seen. You would not give Egeon to Cowley for the afternoon.

relations.quote: Thou hast not the breath before the entrance.

title: Changed three cues and kept Egeon

story.body: The picture holds Nick's hands, the roll, the yard boards, and the brazier. It does not hold a face turned toward you.

title: Looked at the roll in Nick's hands

story.body: You struck the old cue in three places and wrote Lord Hastings, my liege, and madam. The speeches under the cues were not rewritten. Larkham had already copied the other roll.

participation.context: Said the line kindly and refused a quarrel.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Named the breath and the consonants, and told you to go home.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

relations.quote: You never sounded so near death, and I say it kindly.

story.body: Kemp told you that you never sounded so near death, and he said it kindly. Phillips said the vowels had gone and the consonants had done the work. You did not turn it into a dispute. You went.

relations.quote: You never sounded so near death, and I say it kindly.

title: Heard Kemp say near death, kindly, and went
